query: SELECT managed_url_custom_hostname.sub_domain, managed_url_custom_hostname.domain_id AS "domain_id: Uuid", managed_url_custom_hostname.cloudflare_custom_hostname_id, managed_url_custom_hostname.is_active, workspace_domain.name AS "domain_name", workspace_domain.tld AS "domain_tld" FROM managed_url_custom_hostname INNER JOIN workspace_domain ON managed_url_custom_hostname.domain_id = workspace_domain.id;
